title: Use the Database Inside Claude and ChatGPT
summary: Rewayaat is now available as a connector, so you can search and read the collection without leaving your AI assistant. Ask a question in your own words and it queries all 32,519 narrations directly — in Arabic or English — and cites what it finds back to this site.
highlights: Search the full corpus by field, in Arabic or English, with the true number of matches reported so an answer can be complete rather than partial
Read a whole chapter in order, with its real size — the difference between "these appear to be the main narrations" and all seven of them
Follow the 47,522 judged similarity links between narrations, each with the reason it was judged similar
Move in both directions between narrations and the Qur'anic verses connected to them
Works with Claude and ChatGPT today, and powers the assistant on this site

guides.name: Add it to Claude
steps: Name it Hadith and paste the connector URL above. Leave Advanced settings empty — there is nothing to sign in to.
In a chat, open + → Connectors and switch Hadith on, then ask your question.
guides.note: Works on every Claude plan; the free plan allows one custom connector. On Team and Enterprise, an owner adds it once under Organization settings → Connectors.
guides.videoTitle: Adding the Hadith connector in Claude

guides.name: Add it to ChatGPT
steps: In chatgpt.com, open Settings → Apps → Advanced settings and turn on Developer mode.
Click Create app. Name it Hadith, paste the connector URL above, and set Authentication to No Auth.
Confirm that you trust the app, then click Create.
In a chat, open + and choose Hadith, then ask your question.
guides.note: Developer mode is available on the web for Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise and Edu plans.
guides.videoTitle: Adding the Hadith connector in ChatGPT

title: Share a narration as an image
summary: Every narration can now be turned into a card you can post or send — Arabic and English together, with the book, chapter and number on it so the source travels with the text.
highlights: Share button on any narration produces a ready-made image
Choose whether to include the chain of narrators, or show the matn alone
Book, volume, part and chapter pages carry the same card as their link preview, so a shared link unfurls with the section it points at
Images are generated on request, so a card always matches the current text
videoTitle: A short walkthrough of sharing a narration as an image

title: Eid al-Ghadeer Release
summary: Major release coinciding with Eid al-Ghadeer: fully redesigned interface, SEO overhaul, and significant new features across the platform.
highlights: Complete visual redesign with new typography and ornament system
SEO-optimized individual hadith pages for 32,000+ narrations
Dynamic sitemap for full search engine coverage
Quranic Insights panel connecting hadith to Quranic verses with tafsir sources
Tag-based topic filtering across search results

title: Filter by Topic Tags
summary: Search results now include topic tags that you can click to instantly filter narrations by theme.
highlights: Topic tag pills on each hadith card
Click any tag to filter results to that topic
Clear all filters with one click
Coverage across 50+ topic categories

title: Quranic Insights — Hadith to Tafsir Connections
summary: Each hadith now shows related Quranic verses with tafsir commentary, connecting narrations to their scriptural roots.
highlights: Quranic verse panel under each hadith card
Tafsir source tree for exploring multiple commentaries
Verse count shown upfront on the trigger tab
Supported by a curated filter pipeline for accuracy

title: Revamped UI and Typography
summary: A ground-up redesign of the reading experience with new fonts, ornaments, and a cleaner layout.
highlights: New font stack: Inter, Source Serif 4, Cormorant Garamond, Scheherazade New
Arabic calligraphy ornaments between hadith cards
Improved readability with better spacing and contrast
Responsive design improvements for mobile

title: Find Similar Hadith
summary: Each narration now shows similar hadith using semantic retrieval powered by a fine-tuned multilingual embedding model.
highlights: Inline similar hadith panel under each card
Upfront similar count shown on the trigger
Tabbed similar hadith browsing with full text display
Hybrid retrieval combining semantic similarity and lexical matching

title: Search Mode and Reading Mode
summary: Two clear working modes so users can either explore broadly or read in sequence.
highlights: Flexible (default) and Exact search modes
Reading controls for book/chapter/volume navigation
Optional filter guidance in reading and browse views

title: Sign In and Account Access
summary: Single sign-in entry with account creation and password reset in a streamlined flow.
highlights: Single Sign In button in the main menu
Create account action inside the sign-in dialog
Password reset available in the same flow

title: Browse by Book
summary: A visual book selector on the home page with cascading filters for volume, part, section, and chapter.
highlights: Clickable book cards with narration counts
Cascading dropdown filters
Direct jump to any section or chapter
